map.按荷载规范计算垂直于建筑物表面的风荷载标准值。: Characteristic wind load normal to the building surface, per the load code.

map.ω_0 按重现期与地区查基本风压: ω_0 is the basic wind pressure looked up by return period and region
map.μ_z、μ_s 按规范表格取值: μ_z and μ_s are taken from the code tables
map.📚 深度解析：风荷载标准值计算（土木）: 📚 In-depth analysis: wind load characteristic value calculation (civil)
map.高层/大跨主体：按基本风压 w0、高度系数 μz、体型 μs、阵风 βz 算各层: High-rise and long-span structures: compute the wind load at each level from the basic wind pressure w0, height coefficient μz, shape coefficient μs and gust factor βz.
map.幕墙围护：取局部体型系数 μs（角部放大）算围护板风压，控制面板与连接。: Curtain wall and cladding: use the local shape coefficient μs (amplified at corners) to get the pressure on the panels and design the panels and connections.
map.风向与开窗：迎风面正压、背风面负压，开敞结构整体风力与封闭不同。: Wind direction and openings: positive pressure on the windward face, negative on the leeward face, and the overall wind force of an open structure differs from an enclosed one.
map.30m 建筑风压: Wind pressure on a 30 m building
map.w0=0.45kN/m²、μz(30m,B类)≈1.39（GB 50009-20: With w0 = 0.45 kN/m², μz (30 m, terrain class B) ≈ 1.39 (GB 50009-2012 table 8.2.1), μs (rectangular windward) ≈ 0.8 and βz ≈ 1.6: wk = 1.6 × 0.8 × 1.39 × 0.45 ≈ 0.80 kN/m², used for the wall and the primary structure at that height.
map.体型系数 μs 怎么取？: How is the shape coefficient μ_s chosen?
map.按平面形状查规范：矩形迎风 0.8、背风 -0.5，圆角/曲面减小风吸；角部局部: Look it up in the code by plan shape: 0.8 for a rectangular windward face and -0.5 for the leeward face, with rounded or curved surfaces reducing wind suction. Local shape coefficients at corners can reach 1.5 to 2.0, which matters for curtain walls.
map.高度系数 μz 为何随高增？: Why does the height coefficient μ_z grow with height?
map.近地风速随高度增大（风剖面），μz 随离地高上升，高层顶部风压明显高于底部，需分: Near-ground wind speed increases with height (the wind profile), so μ_z rises with the distance above ground and the wind pressure at the top of a high-rise is clearly higher than at the base. Compute it level by level.
map.阵风系数 βz 是什么？: What is the gust coefficient β_z?
map.反映脉动风对瞬时风压的放大，柔结构（高耸、大跨）βz 大，刚性低层可取 1.0~: It reflects the amplification of instantaneous pressure by fluctuating wind. Flexible structures (tall and slender, long-span) have a large β_z while low-rise rigid buildings may take 1.0 to 1.1. It affects the dynamic response.
